methods.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
methods.description: Augments large language models by retrieving relevant knowledge to mitigate hallucinations and enhance response quality.

methods.name: MultiHop-RAG (dataset construction)
methods.description: A procedure for building the MultiHop-RAG dataset, involving steps like dataset collection, evidence extraction, claim/bridge generation, query/answer generation, and quality assurance.

methods.name: Similarity matching methods
methods.description: Traditional methods like cosine similarity used for retrieving evidence.

methods.name: LlamaIndex
methods.description: An LLM-based framework specializing in supporting RAG pipelines, used to implement the RAG system in experiments.

methods.name: LangChain
methods.description: An LLM-based framework specializing in supporting RAG pipelines.

methods.name: GPT-4 (data generator)
methods.description: Used to automatically generate high-quality multi-hop queries, rephrase evidence into claims, identify bridge-entities and bridge-topics, and generate queries and answers. Also used for quality assurance.

methods.name: UniEval
methods.description: A framework used for fact-checking to verify the alignment between generated claims and original evidence.

methods.name: mediastack API
methods.description: A REST API interface used for downloading worldwide news data for dataset collection.

methods.name: Trained language model (for evidence extraction)
methods.description: Used to extract factual or opinion sentences from news articles.

methods.name: Manual review
methods.description: A quality assurance approach involving human examination of a subset sample of generated multi-hop queries, evidence sets, and answers.

methods.name: LLM (response generation)
methods.description: A large language model used to generate a final answer given a user query, retrieved chunks, and an optional prompt.

methods.name: Embedding models
methods.description: Models used to transform document chunks into vector representations for storage in an embedding database, compared for retrieving evidence.

datasets.name: MultiHop-RAG
datasets.description: A novel dataset developed for benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for multi-hop queries, consisting of a knowledge base, multi-hop queries, ground-truth answers, and supporting evidence.

datasets.name: English news article dataset
datasets.description: The underlying RAG knowledge base for MultiHop-RAG, collected from various English-language news websites.

datasets.name: RGB
datasets.description: An existing RAG benchmark dataset that primarily evaluates queries solvable with a single piece of evidence.

datasets.name: RECALL
datasets.description: An existing RAG benchmark dataset that primarily evaluates queries solvable with a single piece of evidence.

metrics.name: Mean Average Precision at K (MAP@K)
metrics.description: A retrieval evaluation metric measuring the average top-K retrieval precision across all queries.

metrics.name: Mean Reciprocal Rank at K (MRR@K)
metrics.description: A retrieval evaluation metric calculating the average of the reciprocal ranks of the first relevant chunk for each query, considering the top-K retrieved set.

metrics.name: Hit Rate at K (Hit@K)
metrics.description: A retrieval evaluation metric measuring the fraction of evidence that appears in the top-K retrieved set.

metrics.name: Retrieval Evaluation
metrics.description: An assessment aspect of an RAG system that compares the retrieved set with the ground truth evidence.

metrics.name: Response Evaluation
metrics.description: An assessment aspect of an RAG system that compares the LLM response with the ground truth answer to evaluate reasoning capability.

concepts.name: Large Language Models (LLMs)
concepts.description: General term for models like ChatGPT, GPT-4, PaLM, Llama2-70B, Mixtral-8x7B, which are augmented by RAG.

concepts.name: Hallucinations (LLM)
concepts.description: The generation of incorrect or fabricated information by LLMs.

concepts.name: Multi-hop queries
concepts.description: Queries that necessitate retrieving and reasoning over multiple pieces of supporting evidence to formulate an answer.

concepts.name: Single-hop query
concepts.description: A query whose answer can be directly derived from a single piece of evidence.

concepts.name: Knowledge base
concepts.description: An external corpus of documents that serves as a source of information for RAG systems.

concepts.name: Embedding database
concepts.description: A storage system for vector representations of document chunks.

concepts.name: Inference query
concepts.description: A type of multi-hop query where the answer is deduced through reasoning from the retrieval set.

concepts.name: Comparison query
concepts.description: A type of multi-hop query where the answer requires a comparison of evidence within the retrieval set.

concepts.name: Temporal query
concepts.description: A type of multi-hop query where the answer requires an analysis of the temporal information of retrieved chunks.

concepts.name: Null query
concepts.description: A type of multi-hop query where the answer cannot be derived from the knowledge base, used to assess LLM hallucination.

concepts.name: Bridge-entity
concepts.description: A shared entity across multiple pieces of evidence that links them for constructing multi-hop queries.

concepts.name: Bridge-topic
concepts.description: A shared topic across multiple pieces of evidence that links them for constructing multi-hop queries.

concepts.name: Claims
concepts.description: Paraphrased factual sentences derived from original evidence, generated by GPT-4.

concepts.name: Retrieval set
concepts.description: The collection of top-K chunks retrieved by an RAG system that best match a user query.

concepts.name: Prompt
concepts.description: An optional instruction provided to an LLM along with the query and retrieved chunks to guide answer generation.

findings.name: Existing RAG systems are inadequate in answering multi-hop queries
findings.description: Existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems are found to be insufficient for answering queries that require reasoning over multiple pieces of evidence.

findings.name: No existing RAG benchmarking dataset focuses on multi-hop queries
findings.description: There is a gap in current RAG benchmarking datasets, as none specifically address the evaluation of multi-hop queries.

findings.name: Existing RAG methods perform unsatisfactorily in retrieving and answering multi-hop queries
findings.description: Experiments reveal that current Retrieval-Augmented Generation methods do not perform well in both retrieving relevant evidence and generating answers for multi-hop queries.

findings.name: Current RAG implementations are inadequate for effectively retrieving and answering multi-hop queries
findings.description: The results from experiments indicate that present Retrieval-Augmented Generation implementations are not effective in handling the retrieval and answering of multi-hop queries.

findings.name: MultiHop-RAG dataset samples show high accuracy and data quality
findings.description: Manual examination of a subset of the generated MultiHop-RAG dataset samples confirmed a high degree of accuracy and overall data quality.
